scientific_question: Does the fixed P=5 PDE track activation-specific nonlinear dynamics better than deep-linear null curves?
continuation: phi_c(z)=tanh(c z)/c for c>0 and phi_0(z)=z

physical_depth_control.criterion: The basic-bootstrap 95% lower bound for C2-vs-C0 Gram separation must exceed 5%, the matched C2 PDE-vs-L64 dense Gram error upper bound must be below 5%, and the point separation must be at least half the L32 separation.

physical_width_control.criterion: Diagnostic only because S=4: C2-vs-C0 point Gram separation must exceed 5% and be at least half the n=128 paired separation; matched C2 PDE error must be below 5%.

pde_depth_control.criterion: N=16 versus N=32 discrepancy below 1% of the relevant common Gram-motion scale for C0, C2, and their activation contrast.

curve_objects: Gram path reparameterized by fractional loss progress
primary_metrics.gram_norm: maximum over aligned depth nodes of the sample-pair Frobenius norm
primary_metrics.learned_increment_rule: Gram and output curves subtract their own t=0 value; loss is 0.5*||ensemble-mean output-y||^2 without initialization subtraction.
primary_metrics.depth_alignment: L32 dense nodes 0,2,...,32 and L64 nodes 0,4,...,64 align to PDE N16 nodes 0,...,16.

common_normalizers.gram: Q_G=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_{t,s} ||Delta G(s,t)||_F).
common_normalizers.output: Q_f=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_t ||Delta f(t)||_2).
common_normalizers.loss: Q_L=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_t L(t)).
common_normalizers.bootstrap_rule: Recompute each common Q inside each paired whole-trajectory bootstrap replicate using the resampled dense means and fixed PDE curves.

decision_rule.confirmatory_case: C2 only. C4 is a preregistered descriptive dose-response stress and is not an alternative route to the confirmatory verdict.
decision_rule.identity_smoking_gun: For Gram motion require simultaneous truth of: basic-bootstrap one-sided 95% LCB[S_G(C2,C0)]>0.05; basic-bootstrap 95% UCB[E_G(PDE_C2,dense_C2)]<0.05; LCB[S_G-2*E_G]>0; and UCB[E_G(PDE_C0,dense_C0)]<0.05. Loss and output are judged and reported separately; passing the same rules upgrades the result to a joint curve smoking gun.
decision_rule.beyond_first_hermite_smoking_gun: For C2 require both basic-bootstrap one-sided 95% LCB[H_G(dense_L2,dense_C2)]>0.05 and LCB[H_G(dense_L2,dense_C2)-1.5*E_G(PDE_C2,dense_C2)]>0. The first condition establishes that the fixed optimal Gaussian linearization itself misses by more than the study tolerance; the second establishes a resolved matched-PDE advantage.
decision_rule.not_just_a_clock: For each C0/C2 dense and PDE loss use q(t)=(L(0)-L(t))/(L(0)-L(T)); require terminal loss reduction at least 95%, and no saved-step loss increase larger than 1e-8*Q_L. After clipping only such numerical-tolerance violations by cumulative maximum, interpolate learned Gram increments on q=0,0.01,...,0.95. With a common progress-path Gram scale defined analogously to Q_G, require basic-bootstrap LCB[dense C2-C0 path separation]>0.05 and LCB[path separation-2*PDE-vs-dense activation-contrast error]>0.
decision_rule.failure: The C2 dense Gram curve does not separate from C0 beyond 5%, or the matched C2 PDE does not improve on the identity null.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Point estimates satisfy a rule but paired ensemble or PDE quadrature uncertainty crosses its boundary.

verdict_hierarchy.full_nonlinear_smoking_gun: Both identity_smoking_gun and beyond_first_hermite_smoking_gun pass, all central C0/C2 PDE numerical gates pass, the matched C0 PDE control passes, and the physical L64 C0/C2 criterion passes. The n=256 width tier remains diagnostic because it has only four paired seeds.
verdict_hierarchy.joint_curve_smoking_gun: full_nonlinear_smoking_gun passes, the identity rule also passes for output and loss, and every preregistered PDE numerical metric—not only Gram—passes its 1% gate.
verdict_hierarchy.strongest_not_just_a_clock: full_nonlinear_smoking_gun passes and not_just_a_clock also passes.
verdict_hierarchy.identity_only: identity_smoking_gun passes, the central PDE numerical gates and physical L64 criterion pass, but beyond_first_hermite_smoking_gun does not; this rejects exact identity dynamics but not an optimal fixed Gaussian linear-gain explanation.
verdict_hierarchy.descriptive_only: Point separations are material but a statistical or numerical gate is unresolved.
verdict_hierarchy.no_smoking_gun: The confirmatory C2 separation or matched-PDE advantage fails at the point-estimate level.

bootstrap.resampling: paired whole trajectories using common seed indices
bootstrap.interval: one-sided centered/basic bootstrap: for statistic T and deviations d_b=T_b-T_hat, LCB=T_hat-quantile_0.95(d_b), UCB=T_hat-quantile_0.05(d_b). Do not use percentile lower bounds for nonnegative sup norms.
bootstrap.multiplicity: C2 is the sole confirmatory activation; C4 is descriptive. Within C2, all required Gram inequalities must pass, so no OR selection is used.

plateau_reporting_rule.pass: A case passes if terminal loss is at most 1e-6 of initial loss and endpoint Gram drift over [6,8] is at most 0.005*Q_G.
plateau_reporting_rule.failure_semantics: A failed case remains valid finite-horizon transient evidence but any claim about its plateau or loss-progress clock test is marked unresolved. No horizon is adaptively extended after viewing dense results.
